About Us.greeting:
We’re David and Dumitru, and TheBakerz means a lot to us. After seeing our friends and family who bake struggle with late-night orders, juggling too many apps, and feeling like they never had time for the craft they love, we knew something had to change.

So we stepped in to help.
About Us.slogan: TheBakerz puts everything bakers need in one place. Instead of bouncing between spreadsheets, emails, and messages, you can handle all your orders, schedules, and customer details from a single, organized spot. Less hassle, fewer headaches, and more energy for doing what you do best—baking.
About Us.why: For us, TheBakerz isn’t just another idea—it’s a direct response to what our friends and family bakers told us they need. We’re here to make it easier, so you can focus on what you love most. Follow us on social and let’s shape a better future together.

FAQ Baker.Answer 1: TheBakerz is an all-in-one platform that helps bakers manage their businesses and reach more customers. It handles orders, production planning, payments, and customer communication in one place. This means less time on admin and more time doing what you love—baking!
FAQ Baker.Question 2: How do I start selling on TheBakerz?
FAQ Baker.Answer 2: Getting started is easy! Fill out this form (link), and we’ll schedule a quick call to set everything up. We’ll help you create your online shop and show you how to use it step by step.
FAQ Baker.Question 3: What do I need to get started?
FAQ Baker.Answer 3: You’ll just need a KVK number, VAT number, and food safety certification. If you’re missing something, don’t worry—we’ll help you figure it out.
FAQ Baker.Question 4: Can I choose my own prices and menu?
FAQ Baker.Answer 4: Of course! You’re in control of what you sell and how much you charge. You can update your menu and prices whenever you like.
FAQ Baker.Question 5: How do orders and delivery work?
FAQ Baker.Answer 5: You decide what works best for your bakery. You can offer delivery or allow customers to pick up orders from your location. Set your own delivery areas and pickup times to fit your schedule.
FAQ Baker.Question 6: What does it cost to use TheBakerz?
FAQ Baker.Answer 6: It’s €29.99 per month for hosting and a 5% commission per sale to cover payment processing. The first three months are free, so you can try it out without risk.
FAQ Baker.Answer 7: Customers pay upfront through our secure payment system. We transfer your earnings, minus the commission, to your bank account weekly. Payments typically arrive within 1-2 business days after Monday
FAQ Baker.Question 8: Is it easy to use if I’m not good with technology?
FAQ Baker.Answer 8: Absolutely! TheBakerz is designed to be simple and user-friendly. If you ever need help, our support team is just an email or call away.
FAQ Baker.Question 9: Can I trust TheBakerz with payments and orders?
FAQ Baker.Answer 9: Yes, you can. Orders are tracked automatically, and payments are processed securely with our payment partner (Stripe). Both you and your customers will have full transparency at every step.
FAQ Baker.Question 10: Can I trust TheBakerz with payments and orders?
FAQ Baker.Answer 10: We’re here to help with anything you need. From setting up your shop to managing orders, contact us or call us at +31 684794739. We’ll make sure everything runs smoothly for you.
